data_fields.name: voice_priority
data_fields.donor_constant: per-sound value in the audio chunk header (values not read)

data_fields.name: music_crossfade_s
data_fields.donor_constant: none (hard cut; fade only on mode change)

best_idea: Give each sound channel one priority slot, so a cue plays only if its priority is at least that of the cue now holding the slot, and re-pan a positioned cue from its stored point every frame.
decision_why: Keep the one-slot-per-kind priority gate and the per-frame re-pan for hit and spell cues, but fix the equal-priority restart, the synth-path position loss and the fixed-source defect, since a boss spell must outrank a hit while a same-cue burst must not restart.
acceptance: A client unit test on VoiceSlot: a priority-3 spell cue starts while a priority-1 hit clip plays; a priority-1 hit started during the spell returns false; a same-cue hit burst inside its cooldown plays once.
